newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU VETS THOMSON/SIEMENS/PHILIPS X-RAY VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: EU VETS THOMSON/SIEMENS/PHILIPS X-RAY VENTURE.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was probing a proposed joint venture between Thomson , Siemens and Philips to develop, manufacture and sale of a new, flat, digital, X-ray detector to be integrated into X-ray imaging systems.

It said in a statement the deal apparently fell under European Union rules prohibiting anti-competitive agreements and abuse of dominant position. There is no deadline for the Commission to take a decision, but it could inform the companies involved of its conclusions within two months.
X-ray systems are used for scientific and industrial purposes besides the healthcare system.

The companies submitted their agreement for EU clearance on August 1, the statement published in the bloc's Official Journal said. The Commission called on third parties to comment. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
